'''DarthVader,AOE Player's Preconstruct Deck 1: Quiet Mining Colony''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[DarthVader,AOE]]
* '''Published:''' 28 November 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Scenario
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Quiet Mining Colony|ECC-L-quietminingcolony.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Quiet Mining Colony
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 QMC DarthVader,AOE LS 2002 PlayersP.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This deck was built by many of the members of GPN for the Player's Preconstruct Project. This is the first deck we've built so far, another is in the works. My thanks goes out to all who participated in the effort- I especially thank Cam Solusar who seems to be online 24/7 just for SWCCG- he's a true fan of the game.

The published list has 62 cards.

== Strategy ==

It's pretty much battle and run here, force drain and run there. Since most dark side decks use alot of Star Destroyers, Cloud City's sector shouldn't be impossible to control. No deck is perfect, but I think we did a pretty good job. I left two slots in the deck to be optional- I'd like to say there was a good reason for it, but actually, I just miscounted. Enjoy!
